description: Unofficial Renji Abarai fan-art companion inspired by Bleach, with original ponytail-tying, headband-tidying, rounded bamboo balance and running animations. Early black robes, one white headband and simplified markings are stylized; covered footwear is a modest desktop adaptation. The bamboo rod is a safe exercise prop. This independent companion is not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
